This description serves as a public history of the project: it must stay understandable to everyone, without code or technical details. The maintainer takes care of the technical side.

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Victor-root/Omnify/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] This PR contains only one change: a fix, a feature, or a cleanup.
- [ ] I tested the change on a real device.
- [ ] If this PR touches the interface, it fits the rest of the app (spacing, alignment, theme).

## Testing

Tell us which device you used (phone, tablet or Android TV), which repositories or sources you tested, and what you actually did. Saying only that it works is not enough.

## AI assistance (optional)

If you used an AI to write this PR, say so here. You must have understood and tested the result.
